overview.title: Architectural overview
overview.desc: The complete origin diorama: vanity desk with arched mirror and perfumes, the standing mirror, the draped crafting altar, the ring lamp, the coat tree, twin beds and the checkered tile grid.

desk.title: The round crafting altar
desk.desc: A round table under a heavy yellow drape, carrying the cup of pastel fineliners, a bowl of sticky notes and the purple sketchbook. Everything here started as a pencil line on this surface.

lamp.title: The stitch ring lamp
lamp.desc: The blue ring light that kept the late hours. Its head throws a circle of warm light straight down onto the fabric, which is why the altar below it is the brightest thing in the room after dark.

laptop.title: The laptop workstation
laptop.desc: The open workstation where garment cutlines, typography prints and 3D clothing simulations are born.

rack.title: The coat tree & lime jacket
rack.desc: A wrought iron coat rack carrying a neon lime jacket, a black gold-hardware bag and a monogram purse.

vanity.title: The vanity mirror & perfumes
vanity.desc: The sculpted arched vanity desk with cosmetic bottles, perfumes and a stool, beside the standing dressing mirror.

quotes.lamp: Where the late hours were lit.
quotes.vanity: Where reflections meet form and colour.

archive.title: In situ archives
archive.intro: Original photographs of the bedroom sanctuary. These raw, everyday moments were the blueprint for the 3D diorama and for the collection.

roomWide.label: Sanctuary vista
roomWide.title: Checkered floor & linen grid
roomWide.desc: The spatial matrix that defines Room 402: checkered tiles setting the rhythm against soft draped textiles, twin beds and the standing fan.

vanityMirror.label: Vanity & horizon
vanityMirror.title: Arched vanity, LED mirror & wardrobe
vanityMirror.desc: The sculptural curved vanity mirror, the cosmetics station, the illuminated standing mirror and the wardrobe holding fabric swatches and finished sample cuts.

coatrack.label: The craft altar
coatrack.title: The altar of sketches & rack
coatrack.desc: The focal hub where the yellow draped crafting table meets the wrought-iron coat tree with its neon lime jacket, gold-hardware bag and laptop station.

epilogue.title: From a bedroom sanctuary to haute couture reality.
epilogue.body: Every silhouette in the collection traces back to this small room. What starts as sticky notes and pencil marks on draped cloth becomes wearable, real-world art.
